name: trackeros
description:
Hey! Trackeros is a corporate ops platform for mid-sized companies. It handles employee self-service (leave requests, balances, expense claims), manager workflows (approvals, team views, time-off calendars), and HR admin stuff (leave policy config, balance accruals, audit reports).
  
  Backend: TypeScript on Node 20 (Fastify), PostgreSQL via Knex migrations + a thin repository layer, BullMQ for background jobs (accrual schedulers, notification fanout). Module structure: src/modules/<name>/<name>.{model, repository,service,controller,routes}.ts. Domain modules include leave, balance, employee, policy, notification. Shared utilities under src/shared/ (db connection, base repository, error types).
  
  Frontend: React + Vite SPA for the web client, React Native for the mobile client (shared @trackeros/contracts package for the typed REST surface). Auth via JWT against the backend's /auth endpoints; identity comes from corporate OIDC in production and from local users in development.
  
  Tests: Jest for unit + integration. CI on GitHub Actions runs lint (ESLint) + typecheck (tsc --noEmit) + unit tests + a Semgrep security pass on every PR. Conventional Commits + squash-merge. Strict TypeScript (no implicit any, strict null checks).
_comment_gate: CI (build/tests/lint/security) runs first via pipeline.adapter. The Gestalt LLM gate (constraint-agent + review-agent) runs after CI passes as a pre-merge architectural review.

rules.description: Use unknown with type guards instead of any
Database calls must go through repository pattern
No hardcoded passwords, API keys, or tokens
Do not add @gestalt/* packages as project dependencies — these are Gestalt platform internals not available on npm

verification.testCmd: find src -name '*.ts' -not -name '*.spec.ts' -not -name '*.test.ts' -not -name '*.d.ts' -type f | grep -q . && npm run build && npx jest --passWithNoTests

_comment_verification: MECHANICAL COMPILE GATE: run in the code-agent work dir before commit; a non-zero exit blocks the commit + routes to self-heal so a compile/type error never reaches CI. Installs deps (clones carry no node_modules), guards on source presence so an empty phase exits 0.

verification.command: npm install --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund && if find src -name '*.ts' -not -name '*.spec.ts' -not -name '*.test.ts' -not -name '*.d.ts' -type f | grep -q .; then npm run build && npx jest --passWithNoTests; else echo 'no source files to verify'; fi
